name: flow_race_without_a_party_cannot_queue
description: On a server without a party (out of it, as after a removal) in a race mode, the hub's button does not offer Find a rival, which would queue nothing (QUEUE needs a party): like High Water's Play there, it plays here, offline, so Race the caretaker where this build has the race's rules and a disabled Play that says the mode comes later where it has not.

steps.msg: on the server, without a party
no Find a rival without a party to queue

steps.assert: (Session.profile.offers('tide_race') and node('HubPanel').primary_text() == 'Race the caretaker' and not node('Primary').disabled) or (not Session.profile.offers('tide_race') and node('HubPanel').primary_text() == 'Play' and node('Primary').disabled and node('PrimaryLine').text == 'Tide Race comes with a later version')
steps.msg: it races the caretaker here, where this build can
High Water there: Play, as before
